The Opportunity

Your patients aren't sleeping. Chiropractic has a role.

Sleep and airway complaints — snoring, fatigue, mouth-breathing, poor recovery, grinding, headaches — walk into your practice every day. Most chiropractors have no structural framework for them, so they refer it all away. Structural Airway Chiropractic gives you one: a sleep-first, skull-down model that respects medicine's role and adds the structural piece only a chiropractor can bring.

To be clear: chiropractors don't diagnose sleep apnea, and nothing here cures it. Our role is structural — and it's a role the field has been missing. CSA is built to be a credible, ethical voice in the sleep-and-airway conversation, never a fringe one.

The Category

What is Structural Airway Chiropractic?

A skull-down, sleep-first model that integrates six things a serious sleep-and-airway division needs:

Sleep-First Thinking

Start with how the patient breathes and sleeps, then work skull-down through the structure.

Structural Correction

Hands-on structural care, including VAET, aimed at the mechanics behind airway and posture.

Home Sleep Testing

The HST is the sleep-and-airway equivalent of the X-ray — the objective data that anchors the case.

CBCT Airway Imaging

See the airway. Ground the conversation in real imaging, not guesswork.

Ethical Collaboration

Work alongside dentists, ENTs, and sleep physicians — referring and co-managing, never overreaching.

Patient Education

A clear, honest teaching model that builds trust and makes the structural role make sense.

Who It's For

Built for structural, posture-aware chiropractors.

  • SOT, AK, CFR, CBP, and posture-focused chiropractors
  • Airway-aware DCs already curious about sleep
  • Chiropractors who want a structural answer to sleep complaints
  • DCs ready to build a high-value division — not another commodity service

Chiropractic Sleep Academy is an educational and clinical-training program for chiropractors.
